Standard Fee Adjustments Effective August 28, 2026, Under Missouri SB 938 Following the passage of Missouri Senate Bill 938, a flat $2.00 statutory fee increase will take effect statewide on August 28, 2026, for recording documents, marriage licenses, and land surveys/plats.

Ov erpayment — In order to provide for the timely recording of documents and to be cost effective, the Recorder of Deeds of Newton County, Missouri, will retain any excess payment of fees up to $10.00. This will reduce rejections and allow for the priority of recording documents so long as the submitted payment is not less than the statutorily prescribed fee.
Each document recorded in the Newton County Recorder of Deeds office is charged a fee. Missouri State Statutes sets each fee and distinguishes recipients of the funds collected. These schedules give a breakdown of the fees and the various fund recipients.
